resources.purpose: Seven-task source outcomes and image receipts
resources.license: Private research evidence; review before redistribution
resources.how_to_get: Recover the selected_successes/retained_failures registry and its referenced outcomes and images from the owner archive. Bind inputs.source_registry to the registry and parameters.resource_base to the restored evidence root. Run doctor --config before execution.

resources.purpose: Independent verification of 1121 retained attempts and 3360 images
resources.license: Private research evidence; public derivative only
resources.how_to_get: Restore the original C587-v3 directory from the owner archive, preserving relative paths; run dafc reproduce --raw-root PATH to verify every entry against reproduce/raw_manifest.json.

resources.license: Apache-2.0; check bundled app licenses separately
resources.how_to_get: Restore or clone https://github.com/google-research/android_world at 3e50888527ef9f29b9157ecd537e408008bb1c85 into {data}/runtime/android_world. Run uv sync --extra android, then uv pip install --no-deps PATH. Upstream exact Python 3.11 dependencies and the current Python 3.12 integration differ; live validation is outstanding.
Recover 2024.05.13-accessibility_forwarder.apk from the verified original Android runtime; place at the catalog path and bind inputs.a11y_apk. doctor enforces SHA-256 before device startup.

Obtain Linux x64 ChromeDriver 146.0.7680.165 from Chrome for Testing or the original runtime archive. Verify the catalog hash, make the executable user-executable, and bind inputs.chromedriver. Install a matching Chrome browser separately.

resources.version: miniwob Python package 1.0; record task source revision per run
resources.how_to_get: Restore the MiniWoB task tree and record its Git revision. Install uv sync --extra browser; start its local HTML service as described by the pinned upstream task source. Record the URL in MINIWOB_BASE_URL for new experiments.

resources.license: Apache-2.0; SuperPoint weights have separate terms
resources.how_to_get: Clone https://github.com/cvg/LightGlue at eb42fee2d71449efb0aa5c10549752b5d75384d8 into {data}/runtime/lightglue. Install uv sync --extra lightglue and start python -m dafc.models.lightglue_runtime_service with --repo and --weights. No weights are downloaded by that command.

resources.license: Check upstream SuperPoint weight license before redistribution
resources.how_to_get: Recover superpoint_v1.pth or obtain the official LightGlue SuperPoint asset after reviewing its license. Put it under {models}/lightglue and verify the catalog SHA-256 before starting the service.

resources.license: Check upstream weight license before redistribution
resources.how_to_get: Recover superpoint_lightglue.pth or obtain the official cvg/LightGlue release asset after reviewing its license. Put it under {models}/lightglue and verify the catalog SHA-256 before starting the service.

resources.version: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct; bind exact checkpoint files in run metadata
resources.license: See upstream model card and checkpoint attestation
resources.how_to_get: Restore the local checkpoint or explicitly download a selected Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct revision. Record the revision and file checksums; uv sync --extra inference; start dafc.models.model_frame_service with --kind qwen25vl --model PATH --audit PATH --port PORT. Save the trusted checkpoint health object as inputs.checkpoint_attestation.
